_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With 0-of-64 windows showing a ±2+ score move, this is a confirmed coil — HOLD is the statistically honest graded call, and the analyst's disconfirming evidence (ETF at 0, VIX 62) blocks any directional launch thesis.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst says HOLD, narrative implies UP; the split is resolved by leaning to the higher-trust analyst plus the 0-of-64 coil base rate.
next_move.confirmed_if: ETF flows recover above 30 AND VIX drops below 45 with funding staying below 55
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF flows stay at 0 AND VIX pushes above 70, forcing a leg down into Panic
